purpose: Evaluation-only comparator catalogues; never automatically added as stellar training truth
execution_status: Andrae/Gaia Net full-source acquisition and frozen-model paired QA accepted on CANFAR as mkoy9zq3; results pending; other comparator arms remain planned

join.dtype: exact int64 or validated decimal strings
join.duplicates: fail or resolve with documented publisher policy; never many-to-many
join.missing: retain unmatched denominator and per-target missingness

panels: catalogue-wide common-ID agreement by original role
paired spectroscopy comparison on identical eligible held-out stars per target
all-comparator intersection as a secondary panel

governance.selection: TUNE/development only; inspected current devtest is not a fresh test
governance.comparison_targets: Teff/logg; native metallicity definitions retained; MH versus FeH explicitly proxy-only
governance.reference_gauge: fixed original three-survey common reference; no evaluation-fitted recentering
governance.training_membership: known in, known out, unknown for each comparator plus MSA ancestry; unknown is not held out
governance.input_budget: record XP/parallax/photometry/extinction/priors; catalogue comparison is not equal-input architecture control
governance.uncertainty: no full PDFs fabricated from point predictions or scalar errors; proper scores against shared references only when distribution semantics are validated

required_outputs: ID/checkpoint/catalogue hashes and per-role/per-target matched counts
raw and quality-cut coverage, missingness and rejection counts
common-reference agreement and paired native-survey/physical-reference accuracy reported separately
Teff/logg/metallicity hexbin/residual panels and Kiel diagrams
median bias, MAE, NMAD, RMSE and outlier fractions; paired error differences with spatial/cluster-block bootstrap intervals
trends versus magnitude, colour, extinction, parallax SNR, sky/crowding and stellar regime
coverage/PIT/CRPS/NLL for validated predictive distributions; point/interval baselines only as supplied
same-star cluster Fe/H scatter and conditional RGB widths with posterior draws and population selection retained

comparators.metallicity_comparison: Native [M/H], proxy comparison to common Fe/H only
comparators.status: earlier-checkpoint paired comparisons exist; current-checkpoint match/scoring pending
comparators.caveat: Distinct from Gaia GSP-Phot; additional parallax/input information and spectroscopic teacher lineage must be retained

comparators.status: publisher table schema verified; current matched data not acquired
comparators.unit_contract: VO Teff/errors in K; original HDF5 Teff/errors in kK; verify gravity/covariance convention from original release
comparators.caveat: XP plus 2MASS/WISE and model/prior constraints; do not treat fitted parallax as independent evidence

comparators.status: author data route verified; native schema and selected rows pending
comparators.caveat: StarHorse training references include APOGEE/GALAH/LAMOST/RAVE/SEGUE/GES; mixed shared teacher and photometric/parallax dependencies; native metallicity definition must be verified
